Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the introductory call last week. We want to take the next step with a focused demo of Redwood Dedicated/Private for our platform team and security reviewers across regions. High-level asks:
- Walkthrough of Dedicated/Private architecture and network controls
- Data residency and audit logs for EU
- Key management (KMS/HSM) integration details
- SLA/uptime expectations for production capacity

Availability windows: we want to include EU and APAC reviewers, so suggested slots (these are local to me/PST):
- Tue May 5: 08:00-10:00 PDT (16:00-18:00 CET, 23:00-01:00 IST)
- Wed May 6: 07:00-09:00 PDT (15:00-17:00 CET, 22:30-00:30 IST)
- Fri May 8: 09:00-11:00 PDT (17:00-19:00 CET, 00:30-02:30 IST)

If those don't work for EU/APAC, please propose alternatives - we want at least one slot that works for EU midday and APAC morning if possible.

Thanks,
Caroline Hughes
Product Lead, FinBank Ltd

Proposed concrete slots (in respective local times) that try to hit EU midday and APAC morning where possible:
1) Wed May 6 - 16:00 CET / 07:00 PDT / 23:30 IST (APAC late evening - probably bad)
2) Thu May 7 - 15:00 CET / 06:00 PDT / 22:30 IST (better for EU/APAC overlap)
3) Fri May 8 - 10:00 PDT / 19:00 CET / 00:30 IST (works for US/EU but not APAC)
